title: COS natural-fiber picks — verified on cos.com
summary:
Every card below is a COS.com product whose composition was verified from the live product record (US storefront where available; Thailand regional mirror for SKUs archived from the US catalog). 17 pieces pass the natural-fiber gate. 16 screenshot items were excluded.

Excluded from the natural-fiber gate or unavailable:
• Slim merino wool crew-neck sweater ($99): Original article 1260173002 was "Wool 100%" but COS has delisted the SKU — CDN gallery is empty and the live US page no longer resolves. Cannot verify current listing so excluded.
• Knitted cotton henley sweater ($99): No current COS catalog entry matches "cotton henley sweater" under men — may have been seasonal/delisted.
• Tailored wool coat ($479): Article 1354271001 — Shell: Wool 72%, Polyamide 23%, Cashmere 5%. Synthetic polyamide fails natural gate.
• Double-faced wool mock-neck jacket ($279): Article 1336468002 — Shell: Wool 60%, Lyocell 40%. Lyocell blend fails natural gate.
• Double-faced wool overshirt ($189): Article 1304465001 — Shell: Wool 60%, Lyocell 40%. Lyocell blend.
• Boiled wool shawl-collar jacket ($189): Articles 1353552002/1353552003 (women) — Wool 50%, Cotton 33%, Polyester 17% (grey) and Wool 48%, Cotton 34%, Polyester 18% (beige). Synthetic polyester.
• Oversized alpaca-blend crew-neck sweater ($139): Article 1306275001 — Shell: Alpaca 33%, Polyamide 33%, Wool 29%, Elastane 5%. Synthetic polyamide + elastane.
• Relaxed twill shirt ($110): Article 1245704015 — Shell: Lyocell 51%, Cotton 49%. Lyocell blend.
• Zip-up cotton overshirt ($139): Article 1351082001 (navy): Cotton 97%, Elastane 3%. Article 1351082002 (beige check): Lyocell 51%, Cotton 49%. Both fail natural gate.
• Textured collared cardigan (no price visible): Article 1358619001/1358619002 — Shell: Alpaca 32%, Yakwool 31%, Polyamide 21%, Wool 16%. Synthetic polyamide.
• Technical nylon-cotton utility shirt ($129): Title contains "nylon" — automatically fails natural-fiber gate.
• Wool-blend bouclé cardigan ($139): Title contains "wool-blend" — automatically fails natural-fiber gate.
• Unstructured cotton-blend blazer ($189): Title contains "cotton-blend" — automatically fails natural-fiber gate.
• Tailored double-faced wool-blend coat ($349): Title contains "wool-blend" — automatically fails natural-fiber gate.
• Double-faced wool-blend bomber jacket ($279): Title contains "wool-blend" — automatically fails natural-fiber gate.
• Relaxed mélange jersey overshirt ($139): "Mélange" is a blended-yarn fabric by definition — automatically fails natural-fiber gate.
